# Content: how the world is built

[Українською](content.uk.md)

**In short.** All of the content — items with their models, maps, interiors, residents, stations, stories, recipes, clothes, holidays — is generated by Python scripts into a single JSON file, `content/base/pack.json`. The main script `scripts/gen_base_content.py` runs the rest in turn through `exec` in a shared namespace, so later scripts see the variables of earlier ones (`items`, `locations`, `residents`, `stations`, `V` — the town map…). The core loads the pack (`Content::from_packs`) and validates it. Separate scripts look for dead ends.

Run: `python3 scripts/gen_base_content.py` (there is a `--legacy` flag for an old core without the new fields).

## Order of execution

| Stage | Scripts | What appears |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Base | `gen_base_content.py` itself | `PALETTES` (palettes), `slot()`, `b()` (model boxes), `item()`, home furniture |
| 2. World items | `village_items.py` (`civic`, `building`, `vehicle`), `facing.py`, `public_items.py`, `world_items.py`, `cute_animals.py`, `town_items.py`, `home_items.py`, `festive_items.py`, `style_items.py`, `town_things.py`, `driving_items.py`, `shop_fronts.py`, `growth_items.py`, `faiths_items.py`, `square_items.py`, `games_items.py`, `interior_items.py` | Buildings, street things, animals, the church, holiday decorations, clothes, signs and cars, shop fronts, building sites, the temple and the old shrine, things of the square, table games, furniture of interiors |
| 3. Maps | `world_maps.py` | The town `V`, the forest `F`, the dump and the rest. Run inside it: `style_world.py` (the new street, homes), `driving_world.py` (zebra crossings, signs), `town_growth.py` (Novobudovna (Новобудовна), the service station, the driving school, the doughnut shop «Пончикова», landmarks), `faiths_world.py` (the temple, the old shrine), `world_more.py` (fields, farm, racecourse, cave, vineyard, cemetery), `town_village.py` |
| 4. Interiors | `interiors.py` (`Inside`), `town_rooms.py` | The rooms behind the buildings' doors, "Visiting" |
| 5. People | `residents.py`, `village_people.py` | Residents with homes, jobs and looks (fixed seed 1991) |
| 6. Economy | `daily_content.py` (finds, fish, the album), `economy.py` (`good`, `key`, `st`, `aid`), `festival_food.py`, `home_life.py` (dishes, recipes, bills), `quests.py` (`quest`, `job`), `first_letters.py`, `rift.py`, `work_garden.py`, `town_life.py` | Pocket things, stations, helps, recipes, the year's stories, the day's small jobs, the first letters, the rift worlds, shifts, the garden, projects |
| 7. Later systems | `craft_items.py`, `media_items.py` (+ `scores.py`), `driving.py`, `growth_life.py`, `faiths.py`, `cinema.py`, `games.py`, `home_more.py` | Crafting and the hardware shop «Господарчий», music, the driving school and service station inside, ice cream and doughnuts, the temple's interior, the cinema, table games, house extensions and pets |
| 8. Widening the streets | `town_widen.py` (runs last, before writing) | The main street gets 4 lanes, the others 3. Everything beyond shifts: props, sites, exits, landmarks, taxi stands, homes, building sites, the car's spot by the service station |
| 9. The town inside out | `rift.py::make_mirror_town()` (after widening) | A copy of the finished town map for the winter rift |

## Items

`item(id, category, w, d, layer, model, slots, acquire, actions=None, surface=False, name=None)`:
- **`layer`:** `floor`, `wall`, `rug`, `surface`.
- **`model`:** a list of boxes `b(x, y, z, w, d, h, slot, shape)`. One cell = 100 units; shapes `box`, `cyl`, `cone`, `ball`, `round`, `gable`.
- **`slots`:** slot → `slot(palette, i)`.
- **`actions`:** `sit`, `rest`, `play_music`, `water_plant`…
- **`tags`:** for example `light`, `fridge`, `water`, `window`, `zebra`.

Pocket things are made with `good(...)` (`carry`), guide keys with `key(...)`. Buildings are made with `civic(id, name, w, d, wall_h, colors, extra, roof_h)`. Building doors are placed by `Map.building_at`.

An item the game no longer has is not dropped from the pack without a trace: its id goes into the pack's `retired` list (see [architecture.md](architecture.md#save-integrity-and-compatibility)).

## Maps

- **The `Map` class** (`world_maps.py`). A grid of character cells with a legend (`LEGEND`): `c` — cobbled roadway, `p` — pavement and square tiles, `h` — a path, `r` — gravel, `d` — decking, `g`/`m`/`f` — grass, meadow, moss, `t` — a dirt road, `o` — earth, `s` — sand, `w` — water. On it go props (`prop`, checked so nothing overlaps), action places (`place`), building sites (`site`, with jobs), exits to other maps, wires, still water (`lake` — it freezes), rivers (`line` — they flow). `building_at` lays a path from the door to the street, `connect` the shortest path.
- **`Inside`** (`interiors.py`) — a room inside a building: walls, a wide door on the south side, an exit to the site's door, staff posts (`post`).
- **Landmarks** (`landmarks`, `town_growth.py::landmark`) — named rectangles, for example `square`, `square_centre`, `main_street`, `park`, `lake`, `beach`, `pier`, `parking_main`, `cart_stop_0..2`, `door:<site>`. New systems place things by landmarks rather than coordinates, because widening the streets shifts coordinates.
- **Flags on props.** `flag` — show only while the town has this flag, `unflag` — only while it has not. Building stages, the full-moon fire, the temple offerings and kiosks are done this way. The content test lets two props share a cell only when they are never visible together.

## Stations, helps, stories

- **Station** (`st`). Required fields: `id`, `location`, `prop` (an item standing in that place), `label`, `text`, `kind`. Optional:
  - `needs` (an id or `#tag`), `cost`, `gives`, `earn`;
  - `per_day`, `hours`, `seasons`, `requires`, `flag`;
  - `days` (`daily`, `weekdays`, `weekends`, `full_moon` or a holiday id);
  - `spent` — the words when it has nothing more today.

  At home a station may not give coins or things from nothing: `Content::from_packs` checks this.
- **Help** (`aid`): a one-time task that opens the way (a key, a place).
- **Story** (`quest`): stages `go`, `bring`, `use`, `cook`, `gather`, `wait`, `choose`; the thanks `thanks`; a window `holiday(...)` or `dates(...)`.
- **The day's small job** (`job`).

## Residents

`residents.py` settles households in the town's houses, gives the adults jobs at sites and the children a school. Later scripts add new people at the end of the list (`res_<n>`) so that nobody's id, home or job shifts: the hardware shop's seller, the instructor and the mechanics, the bakers of «Пончикова», the temple's keeper. A job is set on its site: `jobs: [{role, from, to, wage, days}]`.

## Checks

| Check | What it looks for |
|---|---|
| `Content::from_packs` (core) | Duplicate ids, unknown references, unknown `days`, earning at home, a model for every item, a retired id that is also live |
| `crates/teul-core/tests/base_content.rs` | The pack loads, items do not overlap (taking `flag`/`unflag` into account), roads are not under houses, the road network is connected, every locked door can be opened, the first session, the taxi, the full-moon circle |
| `scripts/check_economy.py` | Every reference exists, stations stand by their props, nothing earns at home, every need fits in the pocket, no dead ends |
| `scripts/check_quests.py` | At least 4 calendar stories every month, and every stage can be done in its season |

## How to add…

- **An item:** `item(...)` or `good(...)` in the matching `*_items.py`. If it is placed on a map, the map must know the item: item scripts run before `world_maps.py`.
- **A building with an interior:**
  1. `civic(...)` in `*_items.py`;
  2. on the map `door, fp = V.building_at(...)` and `V.site(id, name, kind, door, building=fp, jobs=[...])`;
  3. `Inside(id, name, site_id, w, h, floor, wall, door_x)` with props and posts, then `locations.append(R.build())`.
- **A station:** `st(...)` (or a function of its own such as `_fst` in `faiths.py`) once both the prop and the place exist.
- **A resident:** append to the end of `residents` (`id`, `name`, `gender`, `age`, `home`, `job: [site, role]`, `look`).
- **A holiday:** in `crates/teul-core/src/holidays.rs` (`FIXED` or movable). A great holiday also goes into `festival.rs::BIG`, and its decorations into `app/src/festive.ts`.

**English.** `scripts/lang_en.py` (run at the end of `gen_base_content.py`) builds `content/base/en.json` from the translations in `scripts/lang/en/*.json` (`{"Ukrainian text": "English"}`). The script reports a new string without a translation; `--missing out.json` writes them out, `--strict` fails the check. Names are transliterated (Липове → Lypove); street names and descriptive names are translated.

After changes: regenerate the content, then `python3 scripts/lang_en.py --strict`, `check_economy.py`, `check_quests.py`, `cargo test -p teul-core --test all base_content` (all core tests are built into one program, `tests/all.rs`).

## Where in the code

`scripts/gen_base_content.py`, `scripts/world_maps.py` (`Map`, `light_streets`), `scripts/interiors.py` (`Inside`), `scripts/town_growth.py` (`landmark`), `scripts/town_widen.py` (`widen`), `scripts/economy.py` (`st`, `aid`, `good`, `key`), `scripts/quests.py`, `crates/teul-core/src/content.rs` (`Content`, `from_packs`).
